summary: Frontend testing completed for Media Gallery 'Select' functionality integration into Packages and Banners. All core functionalities working correctly: Browse Gallery buttons open Media Gallery modal, Select button auto-fills URL into respective input fields, modal closes after selection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Media Gallery Select functionality fully tested across all sections. All Browse Gallery buttons work correctly and auto-fill URLs after image selection.

admin_login.details: Login with admin/admin123 works correctly, redirects to /admin/dashboard

hero_banners_editor_desktop_browse_galle.details: Browse Gallery button next to Desktop Image URL opens Media Gallery modal. Clicking Select on image auto-fills URL into Desktop Image URL input.

hero_banners_editor_mobile_browse_galler.details: Browse Gallery button next to Mobile Image URL opens Media Gallery modal. Same flow as desktop.

packages_browse_gallery.details: In Package Manager, Edit Package modal -> Basic tab has Browse Gallery button next to Image URL. Clicking Select auto-fills URL.

india_holidays_desktop_banner_browse_gal.details: India Holidays -> Banner Configuration -> Desktop Banner Image URL has Browse Gallery. Clicking Select auto-fills URL.

india_holidays_mobile_banner_browse_gall.details: India Holidays -> Banner Configuration -> Mobile Banner Image URL has Browse Gallery. Same flow.

international_holidays_desktop_banner_br.details: International Holidays -> Banner Configuration -> Desktop Banner Image URL has Browse Gallery. Clicking Select auto-fills URL.

international_holidays_mobile_banner_bro.details: International Holidays -> Banner Configuration -> Mobile Banner Image URL has Browse Gallery. Same flow.

media_gallery_close_without_selection.details: Media Gallery modal can be closed via X button without selecting anything. URL input remains unchanged.

banners_editor.url_auto_fill: Working - URL changes from unsplash to uploaded image URL

india_holidays.url_auto_fill: Working - URL changes from example.com to uploaded image URL

international_holidays.url_auto_fill: Working - URL changes from example.com to uploaded image URL
